title: Another  Piece of Plastic
text: Another  Piece of Plastic. Once again an item delivered with no instructions. There are 3 miscellaneous plastic pieces included. Finally figured out that they are supposed to be dividers for the bins. The bins are so small that dividers seem unnecessary. very thin side panels. Not very sturdy. I'm hoping it will still work as a piece of display furniture on my art vending table.

product_metadata.title: HAITIAN Coffee Condiment Snack Organizer Dividable Compartments for both Office and Home use, Handmade of Black ABS Sheet and Clear Perspex Front Panel, Stable and Machine Washable storage
features: Sturdy & Durable – this organizer is made of 3mm thick textured ABS plastic sheet and clear Acrylic
Easy Cleaning – clean with mild detergent and machine washable
Flexible Arrangements – with one divider for every shelf, you may put 3 to 6 kinds of k-cups, creamers, tea bags, sugar packages or snacks in the different compartments of this holder
Stable – Bottom silica gel grippers keep unit in place
Used both in office and home – organize a coffee station in the break room, on an open counter area in the kitchen. Widely used in coffee shop, buffets and party
